message: The plan-build skill says to set docs/foundry.json baseBranch to the branch the planner is on (here build/cli-smoke), but the project's docs/SPEC.md §7 orders the plan stage to keep the pre-seeded baseBranch "main". The two directives contradict when the operator pre-creates a build/ worktree; I followed SPEC and kept "main". The skill should say which wins when SPEC pre-seeds foundry.json.

P5-01 uncovered a genuine cross-flight defect (multisite conversion silently regenerates the root key and strands all pre-conversion secrets, contradicting docs/spec/network.md), not a Foundry-tooling issue. Logging here only because diagnosing it (querying wp_options vs wp_sitemeta by hand, confirming no migration hook exists) consumed most of the task's time before the block; no PLAN task in this repo owns the src/ fix, so it may resurface in a later round unless routed to the flight that owns src/wp-includes/class-wp-secrets-key-manager.php.

foundry_review_submit's unblock resets a task to todo in place, and foundry_task_next picks the first todo in PROGRESS order, so an unblocked P5-01 would run before the R1-01 fix it needs and block again. There is no way to say "unblock P5-01 after R1-01", so the reviewer has to leave P5-01 blocked this round and unblock it next round, which adds a review round and makes that round count as non-converging.
